sentences.en: What did the businessman say when he invented the zip-fastener?
sentences.zh: 这位商人发明了拉链后说了什么？

sentences.en: The truth is he has a habit of inventing lies.
sentences.zh: 事实是他有编造谎言的习惯。

sentences.en: It wasn't always easy for Edison to invent new things.
sentences.zh: 爱迪生想出新东西并不总是那么容易。

senses.zh: 发明, 创造, 编造, 捏造
